headline: Narail: Husband arrested for killing wife over 'TikTok addiction'
summary: A man has been detained by police in Narail after allegedly murdering his wife due to her use of the social media platform TikTok.
details: A man has been arrested in Narail for allegedly killing his wife. The incident occurred in the Lohagoda area of the district.
According to reports, the husband committed the crime because he was dissatisfied with his wife's 'addiction' to TikTok.
Police arrived at the scene and detained the suspect following the discovery of the woman's death.
The authorities are continuing their investigation into the case to determine the exact circumstances of the murder.

headline_marked: 2 dead, 40 injured in [[clash over cemetery fence]] in Habiganj
headline: 2 dead, 40 injured in clash over cemetery fence in Habiganj
summary: Violence erupted between two groups over a dispute regarding the fencing of a graveyard, leaving multiple casualties.
details: A violent clash broke out in Habiganj over a dispute regarding the installation of a fence around a cemetery.
The conflict resulted in the deaths of two people and left approximately 40 others injured.
Local authorities and police have intervened to restore order in the area following the incident.
The injured have been transported to nearby hospitals for medical treatment.
